text:
[LCSP.3.6] **No bound on series identity cardinality.** A `series`
declared `by:` an identity slot keeps per-identity state, and the
engine creates that state on first sight of an identity — at pump time.
An event trace carrying an unbounded number of distinct identities grows
the series registry without bound. `constspace` does not cap this and
does not fail on it.

The integrator bounds it, by bounding what it asserts. This is the same
division as [LCSP.3.5] and the same as [LCSP.7], where the integrator
sizes the pools: `constspace` bounds the structures it declares, and
the event trace is not one of them.
